status: Approved source reuse and animation direction; runtime size/motion/occlusion acceptance pending
selection: Sean: huge cosmetic fart, giant cloud behind player, approximately8seconds; no forces or damage.
source_preservation: Reuse existing approved PNG unchanged; preserve native partial alpha, no hard scissor.
ordinary_fidget: Existing ordinary cloud and small bubble effect remain independent; do not change their lifetime or material.

anchor.space: World coordinates captured once on activation
anchor.location: Behind rider rear/seat, in airborne space above board; snapshot travel direction at release.
anchor.growth: Keep leading visible cloud edge behind release point; expand predominantly backward. Compute center from anchored leading edge and current half-width; never parent or re-anchor to moving rider.

animation.growth_curve: smoothstep; thereafter continuous very small billow, no frame flipping

billow.method: Smooth localized UV/mesh deformation of existing cloud texture; pin leading edge, constrain displacement to transparent texture margins. No scrolling whole-cloud texture wrap.

animation.opacity_curve: Continuous eased interpolation; all motion and lifetime freeze on pause.
animation.note: Source has a soft irregular silhouette and internal curls; do not create a giant opaque brown rectangle.

rendering.orientation: Camera-facing billboard using existing cloud renderer; preserve texture aspect ratio.
rendering.material: Dedicated instance opacity/deformation parameters, not shared ordinary-fidget material.
rendering.priority: Behind rider and forthcoming gameplay hazards. Keep cloud volume behind release; if camera projection overlaps hero or upcoming hazard, locally reduce opacity rather than hide that hazard.
rendering.readability: No HUD coverage. The rider must visibly leave the cloud behind. Offscreen travel may shorten visible screen time; never chase the camera to force8seconds onscreen.

lifecycle.end: Expire at8seconds; safe offscreen cleanup allowed when no return visibility is possible. Clear on death/retry/scene teardown.
lifecycle.activation: Use approved super input/charge policy supplied by Engineering; this art contract does not alter counts or cooldown.
lifecycle.safety: No collision, damage, impulse, hop, propulsion, obstacle removal or enemy effect.

acceptance: Inspect activation/growth/hold/fade at native play size for bothheroes and supportedcameraangles.
Verify fixedworldanchor during board movement, turn and camera movement.
Confirm hero and upcoming hazards stay readable; eight-second lifecycle may leaveviewport naturally.
Confirm ordinaryfidget unchanged and cloud cleared onreset; no mechanics effects.
